Submitted 1e29ab3c main.cpp:272–275 relaxes acceptance to max(target,0.1), :307–314 also accepts any reduction at the cap, :317–322 counts that as target success and :348–349 declares periodic. Workspace forces SHA256 399a6ab0c64cfff3da086b9fbe767305828dfce5280cc6e20b090009df8d2436 over t180–300 show Cd21.01216..21.23840 and Cl3.74469..3.82989, with no substantiated periodic shedding.
